resources.name: BPVB crystal structure (CCDC 628422)

access.notes: CIF file obtainable from the Cambridge Crystallographic Data Centre (https://www.ccdc.cam.ac.uk/) using deposition number 628422.

resources.notes: Publicly accessible crystal structure; required for all crystal-level calculations.

resources.name: Quantum chemistry / DFT software (ORCA, Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Open-source alternatives ORCA or Quantum ESPRESSO; the paper used Gaussian 09, but the task can be fulfilled with these open tools at B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p) and GGA-PBE levels.

resources.notes: Must support molecular DFT (B3LYP/6-311++G(d,p)) and periodic DFT (GGA-PBE).

access.notes: For post-processing anisotropy relations and mobility formulas; optional but recommended.
